verdict.rationale: Square's Locations API explicitly supports multiple locations (docs-9, docs-24) with per-location settings like custom receipt text (docs-27) editable via Dashboard (docs-15), which supports the core of running multiple locations. However, there is no explicit evidence of per-location device fleet management or per-location reporting dashboards beyond the general Locations API. Missing for 10: explicit device-fleet management per location, per-location analytics/reporting evidence, independent hands-on corroboration of multi-location workflows.
